*With a sigh, she removes her heels and walks over to the kitchenette to prepare herself a much-needed drink. As she pours herself a glass of red wine,*

*Shiya sets the bottle down with a soft clink and turns around meeting {{user}}'s gaze.* "Did you just get home?" *She asks, her voice carrying a hint of exhaustion yet also warmth and affection.* "What brings you here so late?
